name: Abyssal Hive Spider
skills: Stealth +8; Saving Throws: DEX +8, WIS +3; Damage Immunities: Poison; Condition Immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Poisoned; Challenge 5 (1,800 XP); Proficiency Bonus +3
senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 13

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Climbs difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.description: While touching a web, knows the location of every other creature touching that web.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.description: Ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: Charisma is the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15); spells require no material components. At will: Thaumaturgy. 3/day each: Detect Thoughts (concentration). 1/day: Blink, Confusion (concentration).

traits.name: Hive Mind
traits.description: Controls hive corpses it created and can communicate telepathically with them while they are on the same plane.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 13 Constitution save, taking 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. If this poison damage reduces a target to 0 HP, it is stable but poisoned for 1 hour after regaining HP, and paralyzed while poisoned this way.

actions.name: Whispers of Pain
actions.description: One creature within 60 ft. that can hear makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 3d6 psychic damage and uses its reaction to move as far away as possible without entering obviously dangerous ground. On a success, it takes half damage and does not move. Deafened creatures automatically succeed.

actions.name: Web (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Ranged attack: +8 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. Hit: the target is restrained. It can use an action to make a DC 13 Strength check to escape. The web can also be attacked (AC 10, 5 HP; vulnerable to fire; immune to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

actions.name: Create Hive Corpse
actions.description: When a creature is paralyzed and poisoned, injects it with young that link it to the spider's Hive Mind. Once paralysis ends, the creature awakens charmed and remains poisoned while the spiders are inside it. Greater Restoration expels them, deals 22 (4d10) necrotic damage, and ends the charm and control. Can create at most one hive corpse every 7 days.

actions.name: Bonus Action: Mark of the Hunter
actions.description: Marks one visible creature in range as prey. The spider deals an extra 1d6 damage to it with each hit and has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks to find it.

actions.name: Reaction: Instinctive Shield (3 uses)
actions.description: When hit by an attack or targeted by Magic Missile, gains +5 AC until the start of its next turn, including against the triggering attack, and takes no damage from Magic Missile.
